suggestion: rename one server, or reference only one of the configs

title: MCP config carries a literal credential
message: MCP config '{artifact}': server '{name}' sets '{key}' to a literal value
suggestion: use a ${VARIABLE} placeholder; published configs are readable by every profile user

title: Profile key is not accepted
suggestion: delete the key

title: Hook definition is incomplete or ambiguous
suggestion: declare event, command, and exactly one script, naming it with script: when the folder holds several files

title: MCP config is not valid
suggestion: write mcp.json as `{"mcpServers": {"<name>": {...}}}`

title: Profile registry is not the one Desktop reads
message: profiles publish to {value}; CoCo Desktop reads only {expected}
suggestion: point skills.stage at the Desktop registry to publish for real, or keep this for rehearsal

title: Profile includes a skill or plugin with errors
message: profile '{artifact}': {kind} '{name}' has errors, so the profile cannot publish
suggestion: fix the errors reported for it

title: Agent references an extension that cannot publish
message: agent '{artifact}': {kind}('{name}') has no version to pin because {reason}
suggestion: fix the diagnostic that names the cause; the reference resolves once the extension publishes

title: File name cannot be published to a stage
message: {artifact}: {value} cannot be staged, because '{found}' is not made only of {expected}
suggestion: rename the file or folder; a stage rejects any other name, so apply would fail partway through

title: Profile names an unknown command
message: profile '{artifact}': command '{name}' is not a .md file under the commands directory
suggestion: name a command by its path below project.commands_dir without .md, such as sql/check

title: Command file is invalid
suggestion: frontmatter is optional; when present it is a YAML mapping of description, allowed-tools, skill, and hidden

title: Profile names an unknown plugin
message: profile '{artifact}': plugin '{name}' is not a plugin under the plugins directory
suggestion: name a plugin folder that has a plugin.yml
